result.summary: Found 1 layout issue where a restaurant title is prematurely clipped mid-character.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' has its final letter 'n' cut off ('Tokumaru Rameı'), even though there is plenty of horizontal whitespace before the rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the width constraint or flex rules of the restaurant title container so the text can utilize the available horizontal space without premature clipping, and use proper text-overflow ellipsis if truncation is required.
